component.name: HashChat
component.summary: Tor-only anonymous messenger (Rust TUI) — Double Ratchet, black + gold; host Tor required

description.p: HashChat is a privacy-first, metadata-resistant messenger. This Flatpak ships the native Rust TUI desktop client (binary hashchat-tui), themed black and gold (logo: chat bubble with hash mark). It is preview packaging — verify claims yourself; see the project threat model and release notes before high-risk use.

A host Tor daemon with loopback SOCKS and ControlPort cookie authentication is required; the Flatpak does not bundle Tor. The ControlPort cookie must be readable by the user (typical path /run/tor/control.authcookie). Never share cookie contents or onion private keys. Transport is fail-closed: missing or unreadable cookie auth, or non-Tor modes, do not silently fall back to clearnet.

Core design goals include Double Ratchet cryptography with forward secrecy, Tor v3 hidden services by default, burner profiles with aggressive isolation, and a panic wipe that destroys local cryptographic material. Limitations are documented honestly in-tree.
Philosophy: minimal attack surface, reproducible builds where documented, and OPSEC-safe wording without overclaiming production readiness.

ul.li: Real Argon2id + AES-256-GCM envelope for Android ratchet export
Live Security Posture system with visual indicators on both platforms
9+ Rust tests and expanded instrumented test coverage
